constitutional_basis: Article XXVII — sensor accuracy thresholds are MODEL_DERIVED from the control requirement (need to detect 5% conductance decline over 30 min).

pressure_sensor.commercial_reference_bench: Honeywell ABP2 series, or Omega PX-409 (research grade)
pressure_sensor.commercial_reference_implantable: Codman MicroSensor (existing clinical ICP sensor) — proven 5+ year chronic implant
pressure_sensor.threshold_provenance: Codman MicroSensor spec sheet cites +/- 2 mmHg accuracy; we tighten to +/- 0.5 mmHg for bench using research-grade sensor. Implantable version uses +/- 2 mmHg (Codman spec) — simulator should be re-run with this looser tolerance before any clinical claim.

flow_sensor_per_segment.commercial_reference_bench: Sensirion SLF3x series (liquid flow sensor) or Bronkhorst mini-CORI-FLOW
flow_sensor_per_segment.commercial_reference_implantable: NONE — custom ultrasonic transit-time flow sensor required. ~24 month development.
flow_sensor_per_segment.status_implantable: HYPOTHESIS (no chronic CSF flow sensor exists commercially)
flow_sensor_per_segment.threshold_provenance: Sensirion SLF3S-0600F spec cites +/- 0.10 mL/min accuracy; we tighten to +/- 0.05 mL/min for bench using Bronkhorst. Implantable flow sensor is a SIGNIFICANT UNKNOWN — must be developed or alternative measurement used (e.g., infer flow from pressure-drop across known resistance).

redundancy_strategy.pressure: Single proximal sensor (P_ICP is global, not per-segment). Sensor failure -> fail-safe to standard shunt behavior.
redundancy_strategy.flow: Per-segment flow sensor. Sensor failure on segment i -> isolate segment i (fail-safe).

sensor_failure_modes.effect: Controller sees wrong P_ICP, may over/under-drain
sensor_failure_modes.mitigation: Periodic auto-zero against atmospheric reference; clinical ICP measurement cross-check at follow-up visits

sensor_failure_modes.effect: Controller reads low flow on segment i, may incorrectly isolate
sensor_failure_modes.mitigation: Cross-check: if F_i drops but P_ICP doesn't rise, suspect sensor not catheter
Fail-safe to passive pressure-reactive valve (standard shunt behavior)
